name: Waypoint Travel
description: Unlock-once, travel-forever nodes. A waypoint is dormant until touched; afterwards it is a permanent entry in the travel graph and travel between any two unlocked nodes is free — the genre's promise is that backtracking is a choice, not a tax. This component owns the unlock state and the teleport, nothing more. Discovery presentation belongs to world.point_of_interest_network (what the map knows), the marker glyphs belong to ui.minimap, and the travel UI is the map itself: this component listens to ui.minimapClicked so the map never has to learn what a waypoint is.

inputs.name: travelChannelSeconds
inputs.description: Cast time before the teleport lands. Zero makes waypoints a combat escape hatch; a short channel keeps retreats honest without punishing errands.

inputs.name: requireDiscovered
inputs.description: Whether a waypoint must be touched before it is a valid destination. The alternative — all nodes open from the start — deletes the exploration loop.

inputs.name: allowInCombat
inputs.description: Whether the channel may start while enemies are engaged. False, because a waypoint that works mid-fight is an invulnerability button.

outputs.name: unlockedWaypoints
outputs.description: Ids of every node the player has activated.
